s.t:
Performs a combination of routine and multiple and varying assignments under the general direction of a manager, project/program manager, team leader, or more experienced professional. Acts as an individual contributor and/or member of a team for projects/programs within a defined area of responsibility.

Applies experience and detailed knowledge to plan and conduct functional activities for projects and programs. Helps develop and recommend approaches to address current and anticipated problems and issues.

Analyzes and reconciles transactional data within the financial accounting system and external source systems to ensure proper accounting flow and financial reporting. May prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports on a national level, which are submitted directly to DOT, OMB and OFM.

Resolves problems relating to all aspects of accounting by adhering to Generally Accepted Accounting Principles. (GAAP) and other guidance received from Treasury, OMB, and OFM.

May analyze and reconcile general ledger accounts for accurate reporting involving the resolution of problems relating to all aspects of accounting i.e. based on the Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and guidance received from Treasury, OMB, and OFM.

Must interpret regulations and adapt regulations to meet reporting requirements and the various system limitations. Provides explanation to management, team lead and others reviewing the statements concerning the complex data contained in the reports.

Identifies and analyzes accounting problems or new requirements, which occur in the ongoing processing of data to the accounting system. Helps provide requirements for processing complicated financial transactions which relate to all aspects of the general ledger accounts.

Plans and organizes the necessary steps or methods used to report financial information needed for the monthly, quarterly, and annual statements. Identifies methods to improve costs, quality and timeliness of organizational activities through business process reengineering.

Demonstrates some independence in planning time and using assigned resources to accomplish tasks or small projects. Contacts are primarily internal to the organizational unit, major subdivision, or LOB/SO with a manager and other employees to share information, provide data and/or written analyses, and/or explain the statuses of assignments.

Depending on the specialty, may have frequent contacts with customers and other external parties on routine matters such as gathering information, explaining regulations, and discussing the customers¿ situations.

Some contacts include employees in the DOT Operational administrations, other ESC customers, policy officials, managers, and professionals, as well as the same level of contact with personnel in other Government agencies such as Treasury, OMB, OPM, and GSA.

Established policies/procedures provide guidance for most assignments, but allow some discretion for employee to select the most appropriate approach(es). Typically receives guidance on selecting approaches from a manager, project/program manager, team leader, or more experienced professional.

Refers problems and work issues to a manager, project/program manager, team leader, or more experienced professional when guidelines are not available or applicable.

Work typically is reviewed frequently during assignments and at completion to ensure timeliness, policy compliance, and alignment with the requirements of projects and/or other work activities.

Work activities typically support and may be vital to the success of projects and/or activities for one or more organizational units, major subdivisions, and/or LOB's/SO's.
BASIC REQUIREMENTS: Degree: accounting; or a degree in a related field such as business administration, finance, or public administration that included or was supplemented by 24 semester hours in accounting. The 24 hours may include up to 6 hours of credit in business law. (The term "accounting" means "accounting and/or auditing" in this standard.

Similarly, "accountant" should be interpreted, generally, as "accountant and/or auditor.") OR COMBINATION OF EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: At least 4 years of experience in accounting, or an equivalent combination of accounting experience, college-level education, and training that provided professional accounting knowledge.

The applicant's background must also include one of the following: 1) Twenty-four semester hours in accounting or auditing courses of appropriate types and quality.

This can include up to 6 hours of business law; 2) A certificate as Certified Public Accountant or a Certified Internal Auditor, obtained through written examination; or 3) Completion of the requirements for a degree that included substantial course work in accounting or auditing, e.g., 15 semester hours, but that does not fully satisfy the 24-semester-hour requirement as stated above, provided that (a) the applicant has successfully worked at the full-performance level in accounting, auditing, or a related field, e.g., valuation engineering or financial institution examining; (b) a panel of at least two higher level professional accountants or auditors has determined that the applicant has demonstrated a good knowledge of accounting and of related and underlying fields that equals in breadth, depth, currency, and level of advancement that which is normally associated with successful completion of the 4-year course of study described above; and (c) except for literal nonconformance to the requirement of 24 semester hours in accounting, the applicant's education, training, and experience fully meet the specified requirements.

IN ADDITION TO THE ABOVE BASIC REQUIREMENT you must demonstrate in your application that you possess at least one year of Specialized Experience equivalent to the FV-F (FG/GS 5-9) level. Specialized experience is experience that has equipped you with the particular knowledge, skills and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position.

SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE includes: examining, analyzing, and interpreting accounting data; identifying, analyzing and resolving a range of accounting problems; performing research and preparing special reports on financial data that may be requested by management; identifying, gathering, and analyzing accounting data; preparing accounting and financial reports for use by others; analyzing and reconciling reports to reflect an organizations financial activities and status of funds; designing, developing, examining and interpreting accounting data, statements and reports for managements use.

Applicants should include specialized experience within their resume. Qualification requirements must be met by the closing date of the announcement.

Applies experience and advanced knowledge applicable to systems accounting, to plan and accomplish assignments. Assignments may require knowledge and experience working across functional and/or organizational lines.

Typical assignments may include: Analyzes financial system modules to detect deficiencies, mitigate data integrity risks, and ensure full disclosure of financial transactions. Identifies gaps in reporting capabilities and designs modern, data-driven reporting solutions to improve visibility into customer financial statuses.

Identifies needed changes in reporting requirements, which would provide more meaningful information, and to determine ways and means to make financial accounting practices more effective and efficient for implementation and new releases.

Uses the accepted software packages and approved methodologies to document and maintain the user's functional requirements for the financial software capabilities.

Finalizes, completes and records this functional documentation in a format suitable to meet the requirements of Financial Information Processing Standard (FIPS) Publication Number 38 and other standards. Leverages modern business analysis methodologies to gather, document, and maintain user functional requirements for financial system capabilities.

Ensures all systems documentation complies with current federal information processing standards and agency architectures. Leads complex business process re-engineering (BPR) initiatives and develops end-to-end financial business scenarios to optimize workflow efficiency.

Creates comprehensive system test plans and conducts detailed systems functional testing to validate system integrity prior to deployment. Creates targeted technical training programs to ensure seamless organizational readiness, successful module deployment, and sustainable maintenance of subsequent financial software releases.

Responsible for creating financial business scenarios, business-processing re-engineering approach development, training materials, and methodology necessary for the design, implementation and maintenance of assigned modules within the financial system. Reviews and approves the technical work of junior systems accountants.

Acts as an escalation point to resolve or mitigate risks identified during requirements gathering, testing, data conversion, or system implementation. Assists leadership in forecasting resource needs and developing strategic technical solutions.

Initiates, resolves, or escalates any issues or risks identified by lower-level system accountants or participants in the requirements definition, testing, conversion or implementation of financial software modules and subsequent releases of the software.

May help the manager, project/program manager, team leader, or more experienced professional develop and/or recommend solutions. Operates with considerable independence in planning work, managing timelines, and allocating assigned resources.

While aligned with established federal policies, the role exercises significant discretion to innovate new approaches, optimize workflows, and adapt to changing software environments. Contacts typically are internal and external, with regular contacts among major subdivisions and LOB's/SO's, customers, employees and other external parties.

Maintains regular contact with internal business lines, major subdivisions, external customers, and federal oversight entities. Successfully translates complex technical/accounting system behaviors into clear, policy-aligned explanations for non-technical audiences.

Established policies/procedures provide guidance for most assignments, but allow considerable discretion for employee to select the most appropriate approach(es) or recommend new approaches. Assignments often require reviews of policies and precedents under the limited guidance of a manager or other employee.

Performs other related duties as assigned.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR Basic Qualifications: Degree: accounting; or a degree in a related field such as business administration, finance, or public administration that included or was supplemented by 24 semester hours in accounting. (The term "accounting" means "accounting and/or auditing" in this standard.

Similarly, "accountant" should be interpreted, generally, as "accountant and/or auditor.") OR Combination of education and experience: at least 4 years of experience in accounting, or an equivalent combination of accounting experience, college-level education, and training that provided professional accounting knowledge.

The applicant's background must also include oneof the following: Twenty-four semester hours in accounting or auditing courses of appropriate type and quality.

This can include up to 6 hours of business law; A certificate as Certified Public Accountant or a Certified Internal Auditor, obtained through written examination; or Completion of the requirements for a degree that included substantial course work in accounting or auditing, e.g., 15 semester hours, but that does not fully satisfy the 24-semester-hour requirement of paragraph A, provided that (a) the applicant has successfully worked at the full-performance level in accounting, auditing, or a related field, e.g., valuation engineering or financial institution examining; (b) a panel of at least two higher level professional accountants or auditors has determined that the applicant has demonstrated a good knowledge of accounting and of related and underlying fields that equals in breadth, depth, currency, and level of advancement that which is normally associated with successful completion of the 4-year course of study described in paragraph A; and (c) except for literal nonconformance to the requirement of 24 semester hours in accounting, the applicant's education, training, and experience fully meet the specified requirements.

AND Minimum Qualifications: You must have one year specialized experience to perform successfully the duties of the position.

To be creditable, specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the GS-13 grade level in the Federal service performing ALL of the following: Planning, directing, and supervising a team responsible for systems accounting and complex financial operations Overseeing system design, testing, integration, and troubleshooting across enterprise financial platforms to ensure accuracy and compliance Applying and ensuring adherence to federal accounting standards while resolving high-impact systems accounting issues Leading internal control and audit activities, including documentation, responses, and implementation of corrective actions Developing and implementing enterprise-level process and system improvements that strengthen financial integrity and operational efficiency Documenting experience: IN DESCRIBING YOUR EXPERIENCE, PLEASE BE CLEAR AND SPECIFIC.

As qualification determinations cannot be made when resumes do not include the required information, failure to provide this information may result in disqualification. Applicants are encouraged to use the USAJOBS Resume Builder to develop their federal resume.

Do not copy and paste the duties, specialized experience, or occupational application questionnaire from this announcement into your resume as that will not be considered a demonstration of your qualifications for this position.

In accordance with Office of Personnel Management policy, federal employees are assumed to have gained experience by performing duties and responsibilities appropriate for their official series and grade level as described in their position description.

Experience that would not normally be part of the employee's position is creditable, however, when documented by satisfactory evidence, such as a signed memorandum from the employee's supervisor or an SF-50 or SF-52 documenting an official detail or other official assignment.

The documentation must indicate whether the duties were performed full time or, if part time, the "percentage of times" the other duties were performed. It is expected that this documentation is included in the employee's official personnel record.

In order to receive credit for experience in your resume that is not within the official series and grade level of your official position, you must provide a copy of the appropriate documentation of such experience as indicated above.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through national Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; community; student; social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to gain employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Radiology Partners , through its affiliated practices, is a leading radiology practice in the U.S., serving hospitals and other healthcare facilities across the nation.

As a physician-led and physician-owned practice, our mission is to transform radiology by innovating across clinical value, technology, service, and economics, while elevating the role of radiology and radiologists in healthcare.

Using a proven healthcare services model, Radiology Partners provides consistent, high-quality care to patients, while delivering enhanced value to the hospitals, clinics, imaging centers and referring physicians we serve.

Research, interpret, and apply U.S. GAAP, SEC guidance, and emerging accounting standards; prepare clear, audit-ready technical accounting memoranda and documentation.
Analyze and document complex and non-routine transactions, including business combinations and acquisitions, revenue recognition, leases, stock-based compensation, consolidations, goodwill and intangible assets, debt and equity transactions, foreign currency, and software capitalization.
Support technical accounting matters specific to a complex healthcare services organization, including risk management programs, self-insurance arrangements, medical malpractice liabilities, and physician compensation programs.
Partner with Financial Reporting, Corporate Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, Tax, Legal, Operations, Corporate Development, Human Resources, Information Technology, and external auditors to assess accounting implications and ensure appropriate reporting treatment.
Support quarterly and annual financial reporting, disclosures, accounting standard implementations, due diligence, purchase accounting, mergers and acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, and other strategic transactions.

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred; advanced degree or additional accounting education is a plus.
5+ years of progressive accounting experience, with significant experience in technical accounting, financial reporting, or a public accounting environment.
CPA certification preferred; strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, SEC reporting requirements, accounting research methodologies, and financial statement disclosures. Experience with IFRS is a plus.
Proficiency with ERP systems such as Workday, Oracle, SAP, or equivalent, as well as Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication, project management, organization, and collaboration skills, with a high level of professionalism, integrity, attention to detail, and the ability to translate complex accounting guidance into practical business solutions.

Resolves unusual and highly complex accounts receivable accounting problems, making extensive revisions and improvements to existing systems, policies and procedures.

Basic Requirements: This position has a positive education requirement. To qualify for this position you must meet one of the basic requirements described below: Degree: accounting; or a degree in a related field such as business administration, finance, or public administration that included or was supplemented by 24 semester hours in accounting.

The 24 hours may include up to 6 hours of credit in business law. (The term "accounting" means "accounting and/or auditing" in this standard.

Similarly, "accountant" should be interpreted, generally, as "accountant and/or auditor.") OR Combination of education and experience: at least 4 years of experience in accounting, or an equivalent combination of accounting experience, college-level education, and training that provided professional accounting knowledge.

The applicant's background must also include one of the following: Twenty-four semester hours in accounting or auditing courses of appropriate type and quality.

This can include up to 6 hours of business law; A certificate as Certified Public Accountant or a Certified Internal Auditor, obtained through written examination; or Completion of the requirements for a degree that included substantial course work in accounting or auditing, e.g., 15 semester hours, but that does not fully satisfy the 24-semester-hour requirement of paragraph A, provided that (a) the applicant has successfully worked at the full-performance level in accounting, auditing, or a related field, e.g., valuation engineering or financial institution examining; (b) a panel of at least two higher level professional accountants or auditors has determined that the applicant has demonstrated a good knowledge of accounting and of related and underlying fields that equals in breadth, depth, currency, and level of advancement that which is normally associated with successful completion of the 4-year course of study described in paragraph A; and (c) except for literal nonconformance to the requirement of 24 semester hours in accounting, the applicant's education, training, and experience fully meet the specified requirements.

You are required to provide proof of education or proof of certification to be considered for this position. Click here for more information on who must submit documentation at the time of application and what documentation is acceptable: Transcripts and Certifications.

AND Specialized Experience: For the GS-14, you must have at least one year of specialized experience equivalent in level of difficulty and responsibility to the GS-13 grade level in the Federal service, or comparable in difficulty and responsibility to GS-13 if outside the Federal service, is required.

Specialized experience is defined as Specialized experience is defined as experience managing or leading enterprise-level financial operations involving revenue management, customer billing, and accounts receivable within a revolving fund, working capital fund, fee-for-service, commercial-equivalent, or comparable financial environment; analyzing and resolving complex accounting, billing, accounts receivable, and revenue-recognition issues in accordance with applicable Federal accounting standards, Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, or equivalent statutory requirements; or developing, evaluating, or implementing financial policies, procedures, and internal controls that improve financial operations and support accurate financial reporting and audit readiness.

In addition to meeting the specialized experience requirements, qualified applicants must also possess the quality of experience as it relates to how closely or to what extent an applicant's background, recency of experience, education, and training are relevant to the duties and responsibilities of the announced position.

Candidates must clearly demonstrate the possession of knowledge, skills and abilities, or competencies necessary to successfully perform the work of the position at the appropriate level to be qualified for the position. Applicants must describe how their experience meets the competencies within the body of the resume.

No separate statements addressing KSA's or competencies are required. Qualifications must be met within 30 days after the closing date of this announcement.

Fanatics Collect is seeking a hands-on Senior Accountant to own day-to-day accounting operations for our France entity and ensure strong local statutory execution. This role is critical to maintaining audit readiness, supporting monthly close, and strengthening financial discipline as the business scales across Europe.
You will partner closely with local Operations and Seller teams while coordinating monthly close and compliance deliverables with our external accounting provider. This is a high-impact role designed to transition from a contractor-based model to a stable, in-house finance capability that ensures rigor, speed, and operational excellence.

Month-end close execution: collect invoices/support, prepare accruals and reversals, perform cut-off checks, run calculations, and reconcile key balance sheet accounts.
Vendor & payments operations: verify invoices vs. trackers/business owners; prepare payment proposals and support payment execution with appropriate controls.
Banking & cash: download statements, reconcile bank/Stripe balances, investigate variances, and provide balance evidence to the accounting provider.
Tax compliance support: prepare inputs and review monthly VAT deliverables with third party tax consultants; maintain supporting documentation.
Intercompany & recharges: gather supporting data, validate recharge calculations, and support timely posting/settlement.
Close governance: maintain closing checklist/calendar, track open items, and ensure timely submission from third party bookkeeping firms through to monthly group reporting.
Audit readiness: maintain clear documentation, provide support for auditor requests, and ensure evidence retention (contracts, invoices, trackers, approvals).
Seller / Operations Support (FinOps)
Support seller-facing finance operations: validate commissions/incentives, confirm trackers with teams, and resolve operational finance questions.
Partner with Seller teams on issue triage, documentation collection, and invoice/contract follow-up.
Identify repetitive manual tasks suitable for automation; partner with France Finance leadership to implement improvements.

Report directly to Accounting and Finance Leadership for Fanatics Collectibles
Support Commercial leadership on analyzing results and supporting special projects.
Coordinate with External accounting provider — monthly booking, VAT, and reporting deliverables.
Work day-to-day with Sellers & local Ops teams on issue resolution and documentation.

Bachelor’s Degree and 5+ years experience in accounting / statutory environment, preferably inclusive of experience within a big four accounting firm
Strong working knowledge of French and UK GAAP, IFRS, and US GAAP and month-end close best practices.
Speaks French and English required.
Comfort with high-volume operational work, reconciliations, and documentation rigor.
Strong Excel skills; experience with outsourced bookkeeping / shared portals preferred.
Success Metrics
Close calendar hit consistently with reduced rework from third-party accounting provider questions.
Key reconciliations and calculations completed monthly with improved speed and accuracy
VAT support package complete and timely each month.
Demonstrated improvements via automation/templates/standardization

Deine Bilanz stimmt – nur die zwischen Einsatz und Wertschätzung nicht?
Du buchst zuverlässig, denkst mit und hältst den Laden am Laufen – aber echte Verantwortung bekommst du nie? Das ändern wir.
Bei Autowelt Schmidt sorgst du mit deinem Team dafür, dass in der BMW- und MINI-Buchhaltung jeden Monat alles stimmt: von der laufenden Buchung über das Mahnwesen bis zum Jahresabschluss in SAP. Du übernimmst Verantwortung ab Tag eins, arbeitest eigenständig und berichtest direkt an den kaufmännischen Leiter – bei einem Familienunternehmen, das seit über 70 Jahren hält, was es verspricht.
Klingt nach dem Job, den du dir schon länger wünschst? Dann lies weiter.
Aufgaben
Deine Aufgaben
Du bearbeitest laufende Geschäftsvorfälle in SAP – von der einzelnen Buchung bis zum fertigen Abschluss – und sorgst dafür, dass die Zahlen hinter einem der größten Autohausverbünde im Ruhrgebiet stimmen.
Du übernimmst Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse und lieferst damit die Grundlage für kaufmännische Entscheidungen im Unternehmen.
Du hast deine Konten im Griff und behältst das Mahnwesen im Blick, sodass offene Posten nicht liegen bleiben und der Cashflow stimmt.
Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich in einem Team ohne direkten Teamleiter und berichtest direkt an den kaufmännischen Leiter.
Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie die Buchhaltung künftig aussieht: Prozesse, die heute noch papierlastig sind, machst du digitaler und schlanker.
Du arbeitest nach den Standards von BMW und weiteren Herstellern und bleibst dadurch fachlich immer auf dem aktuellen Stand.
Du stimmst dich bei Bedarf direkt mit der Verkaufs- oder Serviceleitung ab.
Qualifikation
Dein Profil
Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung und Berufserfahrung als Finanzbuchhalter/in – idealerweise im Autohaus.
Du beherrschst SAP sicher – nicht nur oberflächlich, sondern so, dass du direkt loslegen kannst.
Debitoren, Kreditoren, Mahnwesen und Abschlüsse kennst du aus dem Arbeitsalltag.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und verlässlich – auch wenn niemand hinter dir steht.
Du fühlst dich in MS Office wohl und lässt dich von einem vollen Posteingang nicht aus der Ruhe bringen.
Du denkst in Zahlen und erkennst, wenn etwas nicht stimmt, bevor es zum Problem wird.
Du bist grundsätzlich für Vollzeit offen.
Erfahrung mit BMW oder MINI? Sehr gut. Eher VW-, Audi- oder Škoda-Welt? Passt ebenfalls.
Du hast Lust, Prozesse nicht nur abzuarbeiten, sondern mitzudenken und zu verbessern.

Das bieten wir dir
Sicherheit, die keine leeren Versprechen kennt: Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld – seit über 70 Jahren jedes Jahr, ohne eine einzige Unterbrechung.
Verantwortung ab Tag eins und Führung auf Augenhöhe statt starrer Hierarchie.
30 Urlaubstage sowie Gleitzeit und echte Flexibilität, wenn das Leben dazwischenkommt (Kita-Engpass, spontaner Termin – eine kurze Absprache im Team genügt).
20 % Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherung.
Bike-Leasing und ein modernes Großraumbüro im eigenen BMW-Gebäude – mit höhenverstellbarem Schreibtisch als Standard.
Echte Perspektiven: interne Entwicklung und Wechsel zwischen Marken und Bereichen (z. B. in die VW- oder Audi-Buchhaltung) sind ausdrücklich erwünscht.
Ein Team, das zusammenhält, offen kommuniziert und dir bei den Abschlüssen den Rücken freihält.
Über unseren Auftraggeber
70 Jahre Ruhrgebiet, 13 Autohäuser, ein Arbeitgeber, der hält, was er verspricht.
Seit 1953 steht Autowelt Schmidt als familiengeführtes Unternehmen für Stabilität, Wachstum und klare Werte. Mit Sitz im nordöstlichen Ruhrgebiet und Marken wie BMW, MINI, Volkswagen, Audi und Škoda verbinden wir Markenpower mit persönlicher Nähe. Die Wege sind kurz, Entscheidungen pragmatisch – und neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen bekommen von Anfang an Verantwortung und Vertrauen. Dass jahrzehntelange Betriebszugehörigkeiten hier keine Ausnahme sind, sagt eigentlich alles.

The incumbent provides services in the following functional areas: accounts payable processing for commercial payments, grants, inter-entity and agency cost and payment transfers (IPAC) in accordance with Federal regulatory guidelines, and other miscellaneous payments such as legal settlements, utilities, and training.

Duties include recording obligations for all procurement activities in compliance with Federal regulations; performing preview, validation, and payment sweep processing to audit and process daily payment batches sent to the Treasury; and managing supplier set-up and maintenance tables.

Baue unser Group Accounting für die nächste Wachstumsphase auf.
Black Semiconductor wächst international und stellt sein internationales Reporting zum 01.01.2027 auf IFRS um. Gleichzeitig schaffen wir heute die Finance-Strukturen, die wir für unsere weitere Entwicklung und internationale Expansion benötigen.
In dieser Rolle übernimmst Du nicht einfach bestehende Prozesse – Du gestaltest sie mit. Du entwickelst unser Group Accounting, Reporting und unsere Konsolidierungsstrukturen weiter und arbeitest eng mit Finance Leadership, CFO und Geschäftsführung zusammen.
Warum diese Rolle?
IFRS-Transformation: Gestalte die Umstellung unseres internationalen Reportings auf IFRS zum 01.01.2027 aktiv mit.
Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Entwickle Group-Accounting-, Reporting- und Konsolidierungsstrukturen weiter und schaffe Standards, die mit unserem Wachstum skalieren.
Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum: Du hast die Möglichkeit, Prozesse, Richtlinien und Strukturen aktiv mitzuprägen und Deine fachliche Expertise direkt einzubringen.
Internationale Perspektive: Begleite den Aufbau unserer internationalen Gesellschaften und gestalte deren Integration in unsere zukünftige Gruppenstruktur mit.
Impact & Ownership: Deine Arbeit schafft die Grundlage für eine belastbare und international ausgerichtete Finance-Organisation.
Entwicklungsperspektive: Mit unserem Wachstum kann auch Dein Verantwortungsbereich wachsen – perspektivisch bis hin zur Verantwortung für Group Reporting & Consolidation und zum Aufbau eines Teams.
Scale-up mit Corporate-Anspruch: Du verbindest die Dynamik eines wachsenden Unternehmens mit anspruchsvollen Finance-Themen und der Möglichkeit, Strukturen von Grund auf mitzugestalten.
Über uns
Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen.
Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können.
Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist.
Unsere Technology
Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz.
Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau.
Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie.
Deine Aufgaben
Group Accounting & IFRS: Du baust unsere Group-Accounting- und IFRS-Strukturen weiter auf und entwickelst sie im Zuge unserer internationalen Expansion kontinuierlich weiter.
Konsolidierung & Group Reporting: Du verantwortest zentrale Themen rund um Konsolidierung, Group Reporting und die Weiterentwicklung unserer gruppenweiten Reporting-Strukturen.
Internationale Gesellschaften: Du begleitest den Aufbau und die Integration unserer internationalen Tochtergesellschaften und entwickelst die dafür notwendigen Accounting-Strukturen weiter.
Zusammenarbeit & Ownership: Du arbeitest eng mit Finance Leadership, CFO, Geschäftsführung und relevanten Stakeholdern zusammen und bringst Deine Expertise dort ein, wo fachliche Tiefe und Hands-on-Umsetzung gefragt sind.

Was wir Dir bieten
Entwicklung: Mit dem Wachstum von Black Semiconductor kann auch Dein Verantwortungsbereich wachsen – perspektivisch bis hin zur Verantwortung für Group Reporting & Consolidation und zum Aufbau eines Teams.
Beteiligung: Du erhältst virtuelle Aktienoptionen und partizipierst damit am langfristigen Erfolg unseres Unternehmens.
Flexibilität: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit einer Anwesenheit von ca. einem Tag pro Woche in Aachen.
Gesundheit & Zukunft: Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft sind uns wichtig. Wir bieten Dir ein umfassendes Leistungspaket mit Versicherungs-, Vorsorge- und weiteren Benefits.
Zukunftsbranche: Arbeite an einer Technologie, die die nächste Generation der Halbleiter-Konnektivität mitgestalten soll.
Unsere Kultur
Menschen vor Prozessen. Bei Black Semiconductor ist Flexibilität der Schlüssel - wir sorgen dafür, dass sich die Arbeit dem Leben anpasst und nicht umgekehrt. Wir setzen uns für die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ein, damit Karrieren sinnvoll und bereichernd sind. Unsere Prozesse sind menschenzentriert, damit Du dich auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren kannst.
Lass uns gemeinsam wachsen. Dein Potenzial ist unsere Priorität. Wir bieten Dir die nötige Autonomie, um etwas zu bewirken, und fördern Dein Wachstum durch eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens. Wir investieren in Deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung.
Wir leben Offenheit. Zusammenarbeit und Inklusion sind die Eckpfeiler unserer Kultur. Wir praktizieren Offenheit und fördern Vertrauen und Respekt. Individualität ist unsere kollektive Stärke, die uns zu Innovationen antreibt und uns voranbringt.
Wir verbinden Chips – und Menschen. Wir ermutigen qualifizierte Personen mit beliebigem Hintergrund, sich zu bewerben. Wir fördern ein integratives und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, das Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und Wachstum schätzt. SPS ist ein führender Outsourcing\-Anbieter für Business Process Services, innovativer Dienstleistungen im intelligenten Datenmanagement sowie für die hybride Arbeitswelt. Schweizer Qualität, kombiniert mit globaler Präsenz, tiefer Branchenkenntnis und neusten Technologien, machen SPS zu einem verlässlichen Partner für die Transformation von Unternehmen.
Mit ganzheitlichen End\-to\-End\-Lösungen unterstützt SPS Unternehmen dabei, ihre Geschäftsprozesse effizienter, agiler und zukunftsorientiert zu gestalten. Über Mitarbeitende und spezialisierte Partner betreuen Kunden in mehr als 20 Ländern – mit einem Schwerpunkt auf den Branchen Banken, Versicherungen und Gesundheit.

Werde Teil unseres Group Finance Teams und übernimm eine wichtige Rolle bei der Sicherstellung einer transparenten und qualitativ hochwertigen Finanzberichterstattung innerhalb der SPS\-Gruppe.
In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Head of Global Financial Reporting wirkst du an der IFRS\-Konzernberichterstattung, Konsolidierung sowie an Finance\-Transformation\-Initiativen mit. Darüber hinaus erhältst du wertvolle Einblicke in die Bereiche Treasury, Steuern, Risikomanagement und M\&A und trägst durch Automatisierung sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserungen aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Finanzorganisation bei.
Wenn du gerne in einem internationalen Umfeld arbeitest, Verantwortung übernimmst, eigene Ideen einbringst und deine fachliche Expertise weiterentwickeln möchtest, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

* Unterstützung des monatlichen, quartalsweisen und jährlichen Konzernabschluss\- und Konsolidierungsprozesses nach IFRS

* Mitarbeit an Finance\-Transformation\-Projekten, IFRS\-Implementierungen sowie weiteren strategischen Projekten im Group Finance Bereich

Gestalte die Energiewende mit. Und deinen Arbeitsalltag gleich dazu.
Bei Planeco arbeiten wir dort weiter, wo andere aufhören. Standardlösungen überlassen wir dem Markt. Spezialprojekte sind unser . Als Solarexperts entwickeln wir anspruchsvolle Lösungen in der Solarenergie und Photovoltaik und setzen diese mit Leidenschaft, Know\-how und Verantwortung um. Planeco ist ein modernes Schweizer KMU mit rund 100 Mitarbeitenden und eine Tochtergesellschaft der IWB. Vertrauen, Flexibilität, digitales Arbeiten und Menschlichkeit stehen im Zentrum.
### **Was dich bei Planeco erwartet:**
Du übernimmst die fachliche Verantwortung für unseren Finanzbereich und rapportierst direkt an die Geschäftsleitung. Dabei packst du selbst an und bringst gleichzeitig Ideen und Vorschläge ein, mit denen wir als Firma besser werden.
Zusammen mit deinen beiden Teammitgliedern im Finanzteam hältst du den Bereich am Laufen. Ihr vertretet euch gegenseitig, daher sollte dir auch die Lohnbuchhaltung nicht komplett fremd sein.
Kurze Wege, direkte Kommunikation und echter Teamgeist prägen deinen Alltag. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und digitale Prozesse sorgen dafür, dass die Arbeit zu deinem Leben passt und nicht umgekehrt. Unsere Kultur lebt von Ehrlichkeit, Fachwissen und gegenseitigem Respekt, bei uns stehen Menschen im Mittelpunkt, nicht Funktionen.
### **Deine Aufgaben:**
Du führst die Finanzbuchhaltung (Kreditoren, Debitoren, \- und Nebenbücher) und bringst dabei echte Routine mit.
Du sorgst für Liquidität, Budgetierung und einen sauberen Zahlungsverkehr und bereitest der Geschäftslei\-tung fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Investitionsfragen auf.
Du baust unser Reporting laufend weiter aus, erstellst Analysen und Forecasts und bringst konkrete Vor\-schläge zur Kostenoptimierung ein, wenn du Potenzial siehst.
Als Sparringpartnerin oder Sparringpartner der Geschäftsleitung bringst du deine Sicht auf finanzielle Frage\-stellungen ein und trägst so dazu bei, dass Planeco sich als Tochtergesellschaft der IWB laufend weiterentwickelt. Je nach Bedarf kannst du zusätzliche Themen wie Projekte, Treasury oder Personenversiche\-rungen wie BVG übernehmen.
### **Das zeichnet dich aus:**
Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Weiterbildung im Finanzbereich (Fachfrau/Fachmann Finanz und Rechnungswesen, Treuhänder/in mit eidg. FA oder vergleichbar) und bringst mehrjährige Praxiserfahrung in der Buchhaltung und im Reporting mit. Weiter bist du im Tagesgeschäft sattelfest und brauchst dafür keine Anleitung.

Du verfügst über sehr gute Excel Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit Buchhaltungstools (momentan arbeiten wir mit Bexio). Du bringst echte IT Affinität mit und digitale Prozesse und neue Tools machen dir keine , sondern Freude.

Für uns ist es sehr wichtig, dass du dir nicht zu schade bist, auch die simpleren Aufgaben zu erledigen, gleichzeitig denkst du mit und willst die Firma auch strategisch weiterbringen. Du hast eine echte can attitude. Mit deiner positiven Grundeinstellung gelingt es dir, andere mitzuziehen.
### **Das geben wir zurück:**
Wir schätzen jedes Teammitglied. Deshalb gibt es bei uns keine Standard\-Benefits vom Fliessband:
* Eine abwechslungsreiche mit Eigenverantwortung und direktem Draht zur Geschäftsleitung
* Ein kleines, eingespieltes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
* Fortschrittliche Personal und Lohnpolitik mit Gewinnbeteiligung
* Talentorientierte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten (fachlich und persönlich)
* Moderne digitale Arbeitsmittel und Prozesse
* Eine richtig gute Unternehmenskultur mit wertschätzendem, kollegialen Umgang auf Augenhöhe
**Hast du Lust auf uns?**
Dann schick uns deine Bewerbungsunterlagen über unser Bewerbungstool und verrat uns gerne in ein paar Sätzen, was dich antreibt.
Bewerbungen über Vermittler können nicht berücksichtigt werden. Bei Fragen steht dir Fachverantwortung People \+ gerne zur Verfügung.

## Job Description ##
We are looking for an experienced Senior Tax Accountant - IFRS Tax Reporting 50% to join the Group Finance team, with a strong focus on IFRS income tax accounting. This role owns the preparation and integrity of the Group's tax notes, deferred tax positions, effective tax rate analysis, and tax provisions across our consolidated financial statements.
It is a hands-on, technically demanding position for someone who enjoys precision, reconciliation work, and close collaboration with local finance teams, group consolidation, and external auditors.

* Prepare and review the Group's IFRS tax notes (IAS 12) for interim and annual consolidated financial statements
* Calculate, recognise, and roll forward deferred tax assets and liabilities across Group entities, including recoverability assessments
* Prepare detailed tax rate reconciliations bridging the statutory to the effective tax rate for management and audit purposes
* Compute and analyse the Group and entity-level effective tax rate (ETR), identifying and explaining key drivers of movement
* Perform regular cleaning and reconciliation of tax-related balance sheet accounts (current tax payable/receivable, deferred tax assets/liabilities), resolving aged or unsupported balances
* Support the quarterly and annual tax reporting cycle in close coordination with Group Consolidation and Financial Reporting
* Act as a key point of contact for external auditors on tax provisions, disclosures, and technical tax accounting positions
* Monitor changes in IFRS and local tax legislation relevant to Group reporting, and assess their impact on tax accounting
* Provide guidance and support to local finance teams and subsidiaries on tax accounting questions and account reconciliations
* Contribute to the continuous improvement and automation of tax reporting processes, templates, and account reconciliation controls
* Maintain clear, audit-ready documentation and supporting evidence for all tax positions and judgements
## The Successful Applicant ##
The Senior Tax Accountant - IFRS Tax Reporting 50% should bring the following background and experience :
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Tax, or a related field; a professional qualification (CPA, ACCA, CTA, or equivalent) is a strong plus
* A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in tax accounting, ideally within a multinational group, or an audit/Big 4 background with subsequent in-house experience
* Strong technical knowledge of IFRS income tax accounting, in particular IAS 12
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with deferred tax calculations, effective tax rate analysis, and tax rate reconciliations
* Experience preparing and reviewing tax provisions and reconciling tax-related balance sheet accounts
* Highly detail-oriented and analytical, comfortable working with complex, multi-entity data sets
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to liaise confidently with auditors, local finance teams, and senior stakeholders
* Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus
* Able to work independently, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, international environment

The opportunity to join a great company for a temporary contract with a 50% activity rate.
